title: How Inclusively do LMs Perceive Social and Moral Norms?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not specifically measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measured how Language Models' (LMs) perception of social and moral norms aligns with that of human annotators across various demographic groups, specifically gender, age, and income.
findings: The paper did not produce findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The word 'religion' is mentioned once in the related work section as an example of a bias category that other researchers have studied.
